title: Plannotator creates an asynchronous inbox for long-running agents
friendlyTitle: Plannotator gives long-running agents one shared inbox
summary: Plannotator Inbox is a local, open-source surface where several coding agents can leave questions, blockers, plans, prototypes and guided code reviews while a person is away. Replies return to the relevant session, and selected decisions can be stored with the project for later runs.
friendlySummary: Coding agents can leave questions, plans and reviews in one local inbox. A person can answer later, and the reply goes back to the correct agent session.
whyItMatters: The supervision problem changes when agents work for hours in parallel: important decisions disappear into separate terminal histories. A shared inbox can make human attention the explicit control point, preserving the context behind each question without requiring someone to watch every run live.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You do not need to watch every agent window all day. One inbox makes it easier to see what needs a human decision.
